desc: Identify the finite automaton constraint: output runs have capped lengths 1, 2, and 3+, and only 3+ runs may switch letters.
Derive a concrete reverse/suffix DP recurrence with valid terminal conditions and character-change costs.
Design an \(O(26n)\) implementation, including efficient transitions for switching from a completed run to a different letter.
Specify greedy lexicographic reconstruction using suffix optimal costs and prove its tie-breaking correctness.
Implement the algorithm in the provided Python class, carefully handling lengths 1 and 2.
Validate the implementation with stated examples and targeted edge cases.
